# llms.txt — Applyr Quick Reference for AI Agents

Project: applyr
Purpose: CLI job application tracker for AI coding agents
License: MIT
Python: >=3.12
Dependencies: colorama>=0.4.6 (only runtime dep)

## Install

```bash
pip install applyr
# or from source:
git clone https://github.com/DeibyGS/applyr && cd applyr && pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

## Quick Start

```bash
applyr init                              # Create ~/.applyr/ with config + DB
applyr setup-agent --agent claude        # Generate agent instructions
applyr add '{"title":"Engineer","company":"Acme","compatibility_pct":75}'
applyr list                              # Show all offers
applyr stats                             # Conversion funnel
```

## Architecture

```
applyr/cli.py         → Entry point, argparse routing
applyr/commands/core.py      → CRUD: add, list, show, update, delete, search
applyr/commands/analytics.py → Stats: pipeline, stats, gaps, trends, compare, plan, salary
applyr/commands/workflow.py  → Export, doctor
applyr/db.py          → SQLite (28 columns, migration system)
applyr/scoring.py     → Weighted scoring (pure function, no I/O)
applyr/cv.py          → ATS HTML + Chrome PDF + recruiter review
applyr/config.py      → ~/.applyr/applyr.toml
applyr/constants.py   → All thresholds and magic numbers
```

## Commands (21 + 5 aliases)

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `init` | Set up ~/.applyr/ |
| `setup-agent` | Configure AI agent (claude/cursor/opencode/generic) |
| `add '<json>'` | Register a job offer |
| `list` | List offers (alias: `ls`) |
| `show <id>` | Show full details |
| `update <id> <status>` | Change status |
| `delete <id>` | Remove offer |
| `search <keyword>` | Search by company/title/tech |
| `stats` | Conversion funnel (alias: `st`) |
| `gaps` | Skill gap analysis |
| `followups` | Pending follow-ups (alias: `fu`) |
| `trends` | Applications over time |
| `summary` | Weekly summary (LLM-optimized) |
| `compare <id1> <id2>` | Side-by-side (alias: `cmp`) |
| `plan` | Learning priorities |
| `salary` | Salary insights (alias: `sal`) |
| `cv generate <id>` | ATS HTML skeleton |
| `cv review <file>` | Recruiter review prompt |
| `cv pdf <file>` | Chrome headless PDF |
| `export` | Export CSV/JSON/MD |
| `doctor` | Health check |

## Testing

```bash
pytest                  # 54 tests, ~0.1s
```

```bash
# No linter configured — follow existing code style
```

## Key Files for Agents

- `AGENTS.md` — Full contributor guide
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — Human contributor guide
- `applyr/templates/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md` — End-user agent workflow (DO NOT MODIFY)
- `specs/` — SDD specifications

## Data Model

SQLite at `~/.applyr/jobs.db`:
- `offers` — 28 columns (title, company, status, compatibility_pct, tech_stack, etc.)
- `offer_topics` — Per-topic scores (tech_stack, experience, projects, education, english, cultural_fit)

## Config

`~/.applyr/applyr.toml`:
```toml
[general]
threshold = 65        # Min % to recommend applying
followup_days = 10

[weights]
tech_stack = 30       # Auto-normalized to sum=1.0
education = 15
experience = 15
projects = 20
english = 10
cultural_fit = 10
```
